mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, the temperature is 79 degrees under clear skies at Verona Area High School, with an air quality index of 55 which is currently in the moderate range.

The Common Council has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan after a unanimous vote to help manage long term development, while our engineering department continues to provide regular updates to the council.

Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard, tomorrow includes yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and next week features community favorites like the downtown farmer's market and trivia nights.

In a report regarding incidents between September 28 and October 5, officers arrested a 19 year old man on October 3 who was found to be a felon in possession of a firearm following a tip from Cottage Grove police.
Culver's is open until 10 PM today, so stop by to enjoy their flavor of the day before they close for the evening.
